Adds the manifest for **Astraeus {{VERSION}}** ({{CHANNEL}} channel).

- **Plugin:** Astraeus by Cosmic Vaults connects N.I.N.A. to the Astraeus observatory dashboard: remote control, an autopilot for unattended nights, calibration and image upload. It needs a Cosmic Vaults account; what it sends to the service is listed in the README's Privacy section.
- **Source:** https://github.com/CosmicVaults/AstraeusPlugin, licensed MPL-2.0.
- **Release:** https://github.com/CosmicVaults/AstraeusPlugin/releases/tag/{{VERSION}}, built from the tagged source by the repository's GitHub Actions workflow. The zip also carries LibVLCSharp and LibVLC (LGPL-2.1-or-later, with some LibVLC modules GPL-2.0-or-later) for the webcam feed's RTSP source, shipped unmodified with their licence texts.
- **Distribution:** I am the author and maintainer of this plugin and am authorised to distribute everything in the release.
- **AI use:** Development was AI-assisted; all code has been reviewed, tested on live equipment and is maintained by Cosmic Vaults.
